You feel a wrenching shift in the ether as {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} body dissolves
into a cloud of noxious gas.

Suddenly, a voice booms out:

    "Thou hast defeated the least of my minions, {quest_current_rank}.
    Know now that Moloch is aware of thy presence.
    As for thee, {quest_quest_nemesis}, I shall deal with thy failure
    at my leisure."

You then hear the voice of {quest_quest_nemesis}, screaming in terror...
nethack.quest.pri.leader_first.synopsis: [You have returned and we need your help.  Are you ready?]
nethack.quest.pri.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}, my {quest_child_term}.  You have returned to us at last.
A great blow has befallen our order; perhaps you can help us.
First, however, I must determine if you are prepared for this
great challenge."
nethack.quest.pri.leader_last.synopsis: [You are a heretic who has deviated from the teachings of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
nethack.quest.pri.leader_last.text:
"You are a heretic, {quest_player_name}!  How can you, {quest_current_rank_modifier_a}, deviate so from the
teachings of {quest_original_alignment_deity}?  Begone from this temple.  You are no longer
{quest_sibling_term_modifier_a} to this order.  We will pray to {quest_original_alignment_deity} for other assistance,
as you have failed us utterly."
nethack.quest.pri.leader_next.text: "Again, my {quest_child_term}, you stand before me.  Are you ready now to help us?"
nethack.quest.pri.leader_other.text: "Once more, {quest_player_name}, you stand within the sanctum.  Are you ready now?"
nethack.quest.pri.locate_first.synopsis: [You have found {quest_intermediate_destination}.  The trail to {quest_quest_nemesis} lies ahead.]
nethack.quest.pri.locate_first.text:
You stand facing a large graveyard.  The sky above is filled with clouds
that seem to get thicker closer to the center.  You sense the presence of
undead in larger numbers than you have ever encountered before.

You remember the descriptions of {quest_intermediate_destination}, given to you by
{quest_quest_leader}.  It is ahead that you will find {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} trail.
nethack.quest.pri.nemesis_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} has sent you, but you are no {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_C}.  I shall destroy you.]
nethack.quest.pri.nemesis_first.text:
"Ah, so {quest_quest_leader} has sent another {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_C} to retrieve
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"No, I see you are no {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_C}.  Perhaps I shall have some fun today
after all.  Prepare to die, {quest_current_rank}!  You shall never regain
{quest_quest_artifact}."
nethack.quest.pri.nemesis_other.text: "Die now, {quest_current_rank}.  {quest_original_alignment_deity} has no power here to aid you."
nethack.quest.pri.nemesis_wantsit.text: "You shall die, {quest_current_rank}, and I will have {quest_quest_artifact} back."
nethack.quest.pri.offeredit.synopsis: [Congratulations, {quest_player_name}.  Keep {quest_quest_artifact}; go and recover the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.pri.offeredit.text:
"You have returned, {quest_player_name}.  And with {quest_quest_artifact}, I see.
Congratulations.

"I have been in meditation, and have received direction from
a minion of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  {quest_original_alignment_deity} commands that you retain
{quest_quest_artifact}.  With it, you must recover the Amulet
of Yendor.

"Go forth, and let {quest_original_alignment_deity} guide your steps."
nethack.quest.pri.offeredit2.synopsis: [{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is yours now.  Return to {quest_dungeon_name} and find the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.pri.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} reiterates that {quest_quest_artifact} is yours now.

"The time has come to resume your search for the Amulet.
{quest_dungeon_name} await your return through the magic portal
that brought you here."
nethack.quest.pri.othertime.text:
Again you face {quest_quest_home}.  Your intuition hints that this may be
the final time you come here.
nethack.quest.pri.posthanks.text: "Welcome back, {quest_player_name}.  How is your quest for the Amulet going?"
nethack.quest.ran.assignquest.synopsis: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} has stolen {quest_quest_artifact}.  Infiltrate {quest_intermediate_destination} and retrieve {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} for us.]
nethack.quest.ran.assignquest.text:
"You are indeed ready, {quest_player_name}.  I shall tell you what has transpired,
and why we so desperately need your help:

"A short time ago, the mountain centaurs to the east invaded
and enslaved the plains centaurs in this area.  The local
leader is now only a figurehead, and serves {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"During our last gathering of worship here, we were beset by hordes of
hostile centaurs, as you witnessed.  In the first onslaught a group,
headed by {quest_quest_nemesis} {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}self, managed to breach the grove and steal
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"Since then, we have been besieged.  We do not know how much longer
we will be able to maintain our magical barriers.

"If we are to survive, you, {quest_player_name}, must infiltrate
{quest_intermediate_destination}.  There, you will find a pathway down, to the
underground cavern of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  He has always coveted
{quest_quest_artifact}, and will surely keep it.

"Recover {quest_quest_artifact} for us, {quest_player_name}!  Only then will {quest_original_alignment_deity} be safe."
nethack.quest.ran.badalign.synopsis: [You are not sufficiently {quest_original_alignment}.  Come back when you have purified yourself.]
nethack.quest.ran.badalign.text:
"You have strayed, {quest_player_name}!  You know that {quest_original_alignment_deity} requires that
we maintain a pure devotion to things {quest_original_alignment}!

"You must go from us.  Return when you have purified yourself."
nethack.quest.ran.badlevel.synopsis: [You are too inexperienced.  Come back when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}.]
nethack.quest.ran.badlevel.text:
"{quest_player_name}, you are yet too inexperienced to withstand the demands of that
which we need you to do.  {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_A} might just be able to do this thing.

"Return to us when you have learned more, my {quest_child_term}."
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_1: "Your {quest_original_alignment_deity} is nothing, {quest_role_name}.  You are mine now!"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_10: "You weaken, {quest_role_name}.  I shall kill you now."
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_2: "Run away little {quest_role_name}!  You can never hope to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}!"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_3: "My servants will rip you to shreds!"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_4: "I shall display your head as a trophy.  What do you think about that wall?"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_5: "I shall break your {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} grove, and destroy all the {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P}!"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_6: "{quest_original_alignment_deity} has abandoned you, {quest_role_name}.  You are doomed."
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_7: "{quest_current_rank_modifier_A}?  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} sends a mere {quest_current_rank} against me?  Hah!"
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_8: "{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} has failed, {quest_role_name}.  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} will never leave here."
nethack.quest.ran.discourage.item_9: "You really think you can defeat me, eh {quest_role_name}?  You are wrong!"
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_1: "It is rumored that the Forest and Mountain Centaurs have resolved their ancient feud and now band together against us."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_10: "You can triumph, {quest_player_name}, if you trust in {quest_original_alignment_deity}."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_3: "Use {quest_quest_artifact}, when you find it.  It will help you survive to reach us."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_5: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} when you face {quest_quest_nemesis}. The very act of doing so will infuriate him, and give you advantage."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_6: "{quest_quest_nemesis} and his kind have always hated us."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_7: "We cannot hold the grove much longer, {quest_player_name}.  Hurry!"
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_8: "To infiltrate {quest_intermediate_destination}, you must be very stealthy."
nethack.quest.ran.encourage.item_9: "Remember that {quest_quest_nemesis} is a braggart.  Trust not what he says."
nethack.quest.ran.firsttime.synopsis: [The ancient forest grove is surrounded by centaurs.]
nethack.quest.ran.firsttime.text:
You arrive in familiar surroundings.  In the distance, you {quest_perception_verb} the
ancient forest grove, the place of worship to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.

Something is wrong, though.  Surrounding the grove are centaurs!
And they've noticed you!
nethack.quest.ran.goal_first.synopsis: [You descend into a subterranean complex.  Hooves clatter in the distance.]
nethack.quest.ran.goal_first.text:
You descend into a weird place, in which roughly cut cave-like walls
join with smooth, finished ones, as if someone was in the midst of
finishing off the construction of a subterranean complex.

Off in the distance, you hear a sound like the clattering of many
hooves on rock.
nethack.quest.ran.goal_next.text: Once again, you enter the distorted castle of {quest_quest_nemesis}.
nethack.quest.ran.gotit.synopsis: [You pick up {quest_quest_artifact} and feel power.  It's time to return {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} to {quest_quest_leader}.]
nethack.quest.ran.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, it seems to glow, and a warmth
fills you completely.  You realize that its power is what has protected
your {quest_sibling_term_modifier_p} against their enemies for so long.

You must now return it to {quest_quest_leader} without delay -- their lives depend
on your speed.
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_after.item_1: "{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  I have not seen you in many moons.  How do you fare?"
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Birdsong has returned to the grove, surely this means you have defeated {quest_quest_nemesis}."
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_after.item_3: "{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} seems to have regained some of his strength."
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_after.item_4: "So, tell us how you entered {quest_intermediate_destination}, in case some new evil arises there."
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_after.item_5: "Is that truly {quest_quest_artifact} that I see you carrying?"
nethack.quest.ran.guardtalk_before.item_: "{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  I have not seen you in many moons.  How do you fare?"
"{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} continues to threaten the grove.  But we hold fast."
"{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} is growing weak.  The magic required to defend the grove drains us."
"Remember {quest_intermediate_destination} is hard to enter.  Beware the distraction of leatherwings."
"We must regain {quest_quest_artifact}.  Without it we will be overrun."
nethack.quest.ran.hasamulet.synopsis: [You have the Amulet!  Take it to the Astral Plane and offer it to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
nethack.quest.ran.hasamulet.text:
"You have it!  You have recovered the Amulet of Yendor!
Now attend to me, {quest_player_name}, and I will tell you what must be done:

"The Amulet has within it magic, the capability to transport you to
the Astral Plane, where the primary circle of {quest_original_alignment_deity} resides.

"To activate this magic, you must travel upwards as far as you can.
When you reach the temple, sacrifice the Amulet to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.

"Thus will you fulfill your destiny."
nethack.quest.ran.killed_nemesis.text:
{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} collapses to the ground, cursing you and {quest_quest_leader}, then says:

    "You have defeated me, {quest_current_rank}!  But I curse you one final time, with
    my dying breath!  You shall die before you leave my castle!"
nethack.quest.ran.leader_first.synopsis: [You have returned, {quest_player_name}.  We need your help.  Are you ready?]
nethack.quest.ran.leader_first.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have returned!  Thank {quest_original_alignment_deity}.

"We have great need of you.  But first, I must see if you have the
required abilities to take on this responsibility."
nethack.quest.ran.leader_last.synopsis: [You are not sufficiently {quest_original_alignment}.  We renounce your {quest_sibling_term}hood.]
nethack.quest.ran.leader_last.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have doomed us all.  You fairly radiate {quest_lawful_alignment} influences
and weaken the power we have raised in this grove as a result!

"Begone!  We renounce your {quest_sibling_term}hood with us!  You are an outcast now!"
nethack.quest.ran.leader_next.text: "Once again, {quest_player_name}, you stand in our midst.  Are you ready now?"
nethack.quest.ran.leader_other.text: "Ah, you are here again, {quest_player_name}.  Allow me to determine your readiness..."
nethack.quest.ran.locate_first.synopsis: [This is {quest_intermediate_destination}.  There are bats nearby.  Beware the wumpus!]
nethack.quest.ran.locate_first.text:
This must be {quest_intermediate_destination}.

You are in a cave built of many different rooms, all interconnected
by tunnels.  Your quest is to find and shoot the evil wumpus that
resides elsewhere in the cave without running into any bottomless
pits or using up your limited supply of arrows.  Good luck.

You are in room 9 of the cave.  There are tunnels to rooms
5, 8, and 10.
*rustle* *rustle* (must be bats nearby.)
*sniff* (I can smell the evil wumpus nearby!)
nethack.quest.ran.locate_next.synopsis: [You are in {quest_intermediate_destination}.  There are pits.  There are bats nearby.]
nethack.quest.ran.locate_next.text:
Once again, you descend into {quest_intermediate_destination}.

*whoosh* (I feel a draft from some pits.)
*rustle* *rustle* (must be bats nearby.)
nethack.quest.ran.nemesis_first.synopsis: [You have come to recover {quest_quest_artifact}, but I shall keep {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} and you shall die.]
nethack.quest.ran.nemesis_first.text:
"So, {quest_role_name}.  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} has sent you to recover {quest_quest_artifact}.

"Well, I shall keep that bauble.  It pleases me.  You, {quest_role_name}, shall die."
nethack.quest.ran.nemesis_next.text: "Back again, eh?  Well, a mere {quest_current_rank} is no threat to me!  Die, {quest_role_name}!"
nethack.quest.ran.nemesis_other.text: "You haven't learned your lesson, {quest_role_name}.  You can't kill me!  You shall die now."
nethack.quest.ran.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"I shall have {quest_quest_artifact} from you, {quest_current_rank}.  Then I shall
kill you."
nethack.quest.ran.offeredit.synopsis: [You have succeeded.  Take {quest_quest_artifact} with you as you go to find the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.ran.offeredit.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have succeeded!  I feared it was not possible!

"You have returned with {quest_quest_artifact}!

"I fear, now, that the Centaurs will regroup and plot yet another raid.
This will take some time, but if you can recover the Amulet of Yendor
for {quest_original_alignment_deity} before that happens, we will be eternally safe.

"Take {quest_quest_artifact} with you.  It will aid in your quest for
the Amulet."
nethack.quest.ran.offeredit2.synopsis: [You are the keeper of {quest_quest_artifact} now.  Go and find the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.ran.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader} flexes {quest_quest_artifact} reverently.

"With this wondrous bow, one need never run out of arrows.
You are its keeper now, and the time has come to resume your
search for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your return
through the magic portal that brought you here."
nethack.quest.ran.othertime.text:
You have the oddest feeling that this may be the last time you
are to enter {quest_quest_home}.
nethack.quest.ran.posthanks.text:
"Welcome, {quest_player_name}.  How have you fared on your quest for the Amulet
of Yendor?"
nethack.quest.rog.badalign.text:
"Maybe I should chain you to my perch here for a while.  Perhaps watching
real {quest_original_alignment} men at work will bring some sense back to you.  I don't
think I could stand the sight of you for that long though.  Come back
when you can be trusted to act properly."
nethack.quest.rog.badlevel.synopsis: [{quest_current_rank_modifier_A} is not adequately trained to handle this job.]
nethack.quest.rog.badlevel.text:
"In the time that you've been gone you've only been able to master the
arts of {quest_current_rank_modifier_a}?  I've trained ten times again as many {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_p}
in that time.  Maybe I should send one of them, no?  Where would that
leave you, {quest_player_name}?  Oh yeah, I remember, I was going to kill you!"
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_1: "May I suggest a compromise.  Are you interested in gold or gems?"
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_10: "I can reunite you with the Twain.  Oh, the stories you can swap."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_2: "Please don't force me to kill you."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_3: "Grim times are upon us all.  Will you not see reason?"
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_5: "It is a shame that we are not meeting under more pleasant circumstances."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_6: "I was once like you are now, {quest_player_name}.  Believe in me -- our way is better."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_7: "Stay with me, and I will make you {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_s} guardian."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_8: "When you return, with or without {quest_quest_artifact}, {quest_quest_leader} will have you killed."
nethack.quest.rog.discourage.item_9: "Do not be fooled; I am prepared to kill to defend {quest_quest_artifact}."
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_1: "You don't seem to understand, {quest_quest_artifact} isn't here so neither should you be!"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_10: "You know, {quest_quest_artifact} isn't going to come when you whistle.  You must get it yourself."
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_2: "May {quest_original_alignment_deity} curse you with lead fingers.  Get going!"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_3: "We don't have all year.  GET GOING!"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_4: "How would you like a scar necklace?  I'm just the jeweler to do it!"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_5: "Lazy S.O.B.  Maybe I should call up someone else..."
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_6: "Maybe I should open your skull and see if my instructions are inside?"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_7: "This is not a task you can complete in the afterlife, you know."
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_8: "Inside every living person is a dead person trying to get out, and I have your key!"
nethack.quest.rog.encourage.item_9: "We're almost out of hell-hound chow, so why don't you just get moving!"
nethack.quest.rog.firsttime.synopsis: [You are in Ransmannsby, where you trained.  Find {quest_quest_leader}.]
nethack.quest.rog.firsttime.text:
Unexpectedly, you find yourself back in Ransmannsby, where you trained to
be a thief.  Quickly you make the guild sign, hoping that you AND word
of your arrival reach {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} den.
nethack.quest.rog.goal_first.text:
You feel a great swelling up of courage, sensing the presence of
{quest_quest_artifact}.  Or is it fear?
nethack.quest.rog.goal_next.text: The hairs on the back of your neck whisper -- it's fear.
nethack.quest.rog.gotit.synopsis: [You pick up {quest_quest_artifact} and know that {quest_quest_leader} should not have it.]
nethack.quest.rog.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, the hairs on the back of your
neck fall out.  At once you realize why {quest_quest_nemesis} was
willing to die to keep it out of {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} hands.  Somehow
you know that you must do likewise.
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_after.item_1: "I was sure wrong about Lady Tyvefelle's house; I barely got away with my life and lost my lock pick in the process."
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_after.item_2: "You're back?  Even the Twain don't come back anymore."
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_after.item_3: "Can you spare an old cutpurse a zorkmid for some grog?"
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_after.item_4: "Fritz tried to join the other side, and now he's hell-hound chow."
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_after.item_5: "Be careful what you steal, I hear the boss has perfected turning rocks into worthless pieces of glass."
nethack.quest.rog.guardtalk_before.item_: "I hear that Lady Tyvefelle's household is lightly guarded."
"You're back?  Even the Twain don't come back anymore."
"Can you spare an old cutpurse a zorkmid for some grog?"
"Fritz tried to join the other side, and now he's hell-hound chow."
"Be careful what you steal, I hear the boss has perfected turning rocks into worthless pieces of glass."
nethack.quest.rog.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to the Astral Plane and find {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} temple.]
nethack.quest.rog.hasamulet.text:
"I see that with your abilities, and my brains, we could rule this world.

"All that we would need to be all-powerful is for you to take that little
trinket you've got there up to the Astral Plane.  From there, {quest_original_alignment_deity} will
show you what to do with it.  Once that's done, we will be invincible!"
nethack.quest.rog.killed_nemesis.synopsi: [Before dying, {quest_quest_nemesis} tells you to use the {quest_quest_artifact} wisely.]
nethack.quest.rog.killed_nemesis.text:
"I know what you are thinking, {quest_player_name}.  It is not too late for you
to use {quest_quest_artifact} wisely.  For the sake of your guild
{quest_sibling_term_modifier_p}, do what is right."

You sit and wait for death to come for {quest_quest_nemesis}, and then you
brace yourself for your next meeting with {quest_quest_leader}!
nethack.quest.rog.leader_first.synopsis: [You owe back dues to your guild.  You can pay them off if you're up to the job.]
nethack.quest.rog.leader_first.text:
"Well, look who it is boys -- {quest_player_name} has come home.  You seem to have
fallen behind in your dues.  I should kill you as an example to these
other worthless cutpurses, but I have a better plan.  If you are ready
maybe you could work off your back dues by performing a little job for
me.  Let us just see if you are ready..."
nethack.quest.rog.leader_last.text:
"Well {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_p}, it looks like our friend has forgotten who is the boss
around here.  Our friend seems to think that {quest_current_rank_modifier_p} have been put in
charge.  Wrong.  DEAD WRONG!"

Your sudden shift in surroundings prevents you from hearing the end
of {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} curse.
nethack.quest.rog.leader_next.synopsis: [Are you stupid or are you ready?]
nethack.quest.rog.leader_next.text:
"Well, I didn't expect to see you back.  It shows that you are either stupid,
or you are finally ready to accept my offer.  Let us hope for your sake it
isn't stupidity that brings you back."
nethack.quest.rog.leader_other.text:
"Did you perhaps mistake me for some other {quest_quest_leader_modifier_t}?  You must
think me as stupid as your behavior.  I warn you not to try my patience."
nethack.quest.rog.locate_first.text: Those damn little hairs tell you that you are nearer to {quest_quest_artifact}.
nethack.quest.rog.locate_next.text: Not wanting to face {quest_quest_leader} without having stolen {quest_quest_artifact}, you continue.
nethack.quest.rog.nemesis_first.text: "Ah!  You must be {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} ... er, `hero'.  A pleasure to meet you."
nethack.quest.rog.nemesis_next.text: "We meet again.  Please reconsider your actions."
nethack.quest.rog.nemesis_other.text:
"Surely, {quest_player_name}, you have learned that you cannot trust any bargains
that {quest_quest_leader} has made.  I can show you how to continue on
your quest without having to run into him again."
nethack.quest.rog.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"Please, think for a moment about what you are doing.  Do you truly
believe that {quest_original_alignment_deity} would want {quest_quest_leader} to have
{quest_quest_artifact}?"
nethack.quest.rog.nexttime.text:
Once again, you find yourself back in Ransmannsby.  Fond memories are
replaced by fear, knowing that {quest_quest_leader} is waiting for you.
nethack.quest.rog.offeredit.text:
"Well, I'll be damned.  You got it.  I am proud of you, a fine {quest_current_rank}
you've turned out to be.

"While you were gone I got to thinking, you and {quest_quest_artifact}
together could bring me more treasure than either of you apart, so why don't
you take it with you.  All I ask is a cut of whatever loot you come by.
That is a better deal than I offered {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"But, you see what happened to {quest_quest_nemesis} when he refused.
Don't make me find another to send after you this time."
nethack.quest.rog.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} seems tempted to swap {quest_quest_artifact} for
the mundane one you detect in his pocket, but noticing your alertness,
evidently chickens out.

"Go filch the Amulet before someone else beats you to it.
{quest_dungeon_name} are back the way you came, through the magic portal."
nethack.quest.rog.othertime.text:
You rub your hands through your hair, hoping that the little ones on
the back of your neck stay down, and prepare yourself for your meeting
with {quest_quest_leader}.
nethack.quest.rog.posthanks.text:
"Quite the little thief, aren't we, {quest_player_name}.  Can I interest you in a
swap for {quest_quest_artifact}?  Look around, anything in the keep
is yours for the asking."
nethack.quest.sam.assignquest.text:
"Domo {quest_player_name}-san, indeed you are ready.  I can now tell you what
it is that I require of you.

"The daimyo, {quest_quest_nemesis}, has betrayed us.  He has stolen from us
{quest_quest_artifact} and taken it to his donjon deep within
{quest_intermediate_destination}.

"If I cannot show the emperor {quest_quest_artifact} when he comes
for the festival he will know that I have failed in my duty, and
request that I commit seppuku.

"You must gain entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination} and retrieve the
emperor's property.  Be quick!  The emperor will be here for the
cha-no-you in 5 sticks.

"Wakarimasu ka?"
nethack.quest.sam.badalign.synopsis: [When you can think {quest_original_alignment} and act {quest_original_alignment} then return.]
nethack.quest.sam.badalign.text:
"{quest_player_name}-san, you would do better to join the kyokaku.

"You have skills, but until you can call upon the bushido to know when and
how to use them you are not samurai.  When you can think {quest_original_alignment} and
act {quest_original_alignment} then return."
nethack.quest.sam.badlevel.synopsis: ["I require {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a} to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Return when you are ready."]
nethack.quest.sam.badlevel.text:
"{quest_player_name}-san, you have learned well and honored your family.
I require the skills of {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a} in order to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}.
Go and seek out teachers.  Learn what they have learned.  When you
are ready, return to me."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_1: "Ahh, I finally meet the daimyo of the kyokaku!"
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_10: "Your master was a poor teacher.  You will pay for his mistakes in your teaching."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_2: "There is no honor for me in your death."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_3: "You know that I cannot resash my swords until they have killed."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_4: "Your presence only compounds the dishonor of {quest_quest_leader} in not coming {quest_quest_leader_modifier_i}self."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_5: "I will make tea with your hair and serve it to {quest_quest_leader}."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_6: "Your fear shows in your eyes, coward!"
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_7: "I have not heard of you, {quest_player_name}-san; has your life been that unworthy?"
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_8: "If you will not obey me, you will die."
nethack.quest.sam.discourage.item_9: "Kneel now and make the two cuts of honor.  I will tell your {quest_sibling_term_modifier_p} of your honorable death."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_1: "To defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} you must overcome the seven emotions: hate, adoration, joy, anxiety, anger, grief, and fear."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_10: "Sharpen your swords and your wits for the task before you."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_2: "Remember your honor is my honor, you perform in my name."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_3: "I will go to the temple and burn incense for your safe return."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_5: "There can be honor in defeat, but no gain."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_6: "Your kami must be strong in order to succeed."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_7: "You are indeed a worthy {quest_minimum_quest_rank}, but now you must be a worthy samurai."
nethack.quest.sam.encourage.item_8: "If you fail, {quest_quest_nemesis} will be like a tai-fun on the land."
nethack.quest.sam.firsttime.synopsis: [The banner of {quest_quest_nemesis} flies above town.  What has happened to {quest_quest_leader}?]
nethack.quest.sam.firsttime.text:
Even before your senses adjust, you recognize the kami of
{quest_quest_home}.

You {quest_perception_verb} the standard of your teki, {quest_quest_nemesis}, flying above
the town.  How could such a thing have happened?  Why are ninja
wandering freely; where are the samurai of your daimyo, {quest_quest_leader}?

You quickly say a prayer to Izanagi and Izanami and walk towards
town.
nethack.quest.sam.goal_alt.text: As you arrive once again at the home of {quest_quest_nemesis}.
nethack.quest.sam.goal_first.synopsis: [You feel the taunts {quest_quest_nemesis}, but after offering a prayer to {quest_original_alignment_deity}, you proceed.]
nethack.quest.sam.goal_first.text:
In your mind, you hear the taunts of {quest_quest_nemesis}.

You become like the rice plant and bend to the ground, offering a
prayer to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  But when the wind has passed, you stand
proudly again.  Putting your kami in the hands of fate, you advance.
nethack.quest.sam.goal_next.text:
As you arrive once again at the home of {quest_quest_nemesis}, your thoughts
turn only to {quest_quest_artifact}.
nethack.quest.sam.gotit.synopsis: [You feel the power of {quest_quest_artifact} and are humbled.]
nethack.quest.sam.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel the strength of its karma.
You realize at once why so many good samurai had to die to defend it.
You are humbled knowing that you hold one of the artifacts of the
sun goddess.
nethack.quest.sam.guardtalk_after.item_1: "Come, join us in celebrating with some sake."
nethack.quest.sam.guardtalk_after.item_3: "You have brought our clan and {quest_quest_leader} much honor."
nethack.quest.sam.guardtalk_after.item_4: "Please {quest_current_rank}, sit for a while and tell us how you overcame the Ninja."
nethack.quest.sam.guardtalk_after.item_5: "{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} still lives!  You have saved us from becoming ronin."
nethack.quest.sam.guardtalk_before.item_: "To succeed, you must walk like a butterfly on the wind."
"I fear for The Land of The Gods."
"{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} has hired the Ninja -- be careful."
"If {quest_quest_artifact} is not returned, we will all be ronin."
nethack.quest.sam.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to the Astral Plane to finish your task.]
nethack.quest.sam.hasamulet.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}-sama.  You have wasted your efforts returning home.
Now that you are in possession of the Amulet, you are honor-bound to
finish the quest you have undertaken.  There will be plenty of time
for saki and stories when you have finished.

"Go now, and may our prayers be a wind at your back."
nethack.quest.sam.killed_nemesis.text:
Your healing skills tell you that {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} wounds are mortal.

You know that the bushido tells you to finish him and let his kami
die with honor, but the thought of so many samurai dead due to this
man's dishonor prevents you from giving the final blow.

You order that his unwashed head be given to the crows and his body
thrown into the sea.
nethack.quest.sam.leader_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} needs someone to lead {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j} samurai against {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Are you ready?]
nethack.quest.sam.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}-san, it is good to see you again.  I need someone who can
lead my samurai against {quest_quest_nemesis}.  If you are ready, you will be
that person."
nethack.quest.sam.leader_last.text:
"You are no longer my samurai, {quest_player_name}.

"Hara-kiri is denied.  You are ordered to shave your head and then to
become a monk.  Your fief and family are forfeit.  Wakarimasu ka?"
nethack.quest.sam.leader_next.text:
"Once again, {quest_player_name}-san, you kneel before me.  Are you yet capable of
being my vassal?"
nethack.quest.sam.leader_other.text:
"You begin to test my matsu, {quest_player_name}-san.
If you cannot determine what I want in a samurai, how can I rely on you
to figure out what I need from a samurai?"
nethack.quest.sam.locate_first.text:
You instinctively reach for your swords.  You do not recognize the
lay of this land, but you know that your teki are everywhere.
nethack.quest.sam.locate_next.text:
Thankful that your {quest_sibling_term_modifier_p} at {quest_quest_home} cannot see
your fear, you prepare again to advance.
nethack.quest.sam.nemesis_first.text:
"Ah, so it is to be you, {quest_player_name}-san.  I offer you seppuku.
I will be your second if you wish."
nethack.quest.sam.nemesis_next.text:
"I have offered you the honorable exit.  Now I will have your
head to send unwashed to {quest_quest_leader}."
nethack.quest.sam.nemesis_other.text: "After I have dispatched you, I will curse your kami."
nethack.quest.sam.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"You have fought my samurai; surely you must know that you
will not be able to take {quest_quest_artifact} back to
{quest_quest_home}."
nethack.quest.sam.nexttime.text: Once again, you are back at {quest_quest_home}.
nethack.quest.sam.offeredit.synopsis: [The emperor wants you to take {quest_quest_artifact} and recover the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.sam.offeredit.text:
As you bow before {quest_quest_leader}, he welcomes you:

    "You have brought your family great honor, {quest_player_name}-sama.

    "While you have been gone the emperor's advisors have discovered in
    the ancient texts that the karma of the samurai who seeks to recover
    the Amulet and the karma of {quest_quest_artifact} are joined
    as the seasons join to make a year.

    "Because you have shown such fidelity, the emperor requests
    that you take leave of other obligations and continue on the
    road that fate has set your feet upon.  I would consider it
    an honor if you would allow me to watch your household until
    you return with the Amulet."

With that, {quest_quest_leader} bows, and places his sword atop
{quest_quest_artifact}.
nethack.quest.sam.offeredit2.synopsis: [Take {quest_quest_artifact}, return to {quest_dungeon_name}, and recover the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.sam.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader} holds {quest_quest_artifact} tightly for a moment, then returns
his gaze to you.

"The time is ripe to recover the Amulet.  Return to {quest_dungeon_name}
through the magic portal that transported you here so that you may
achieve the destiny which awaits you."
nethack.quest.sam.othertime.text:
You are back at {quest_quest_home}.

Instantly you sense a subtle change in your karma.  You seem to know that
if you do not succeed in your quest, {quest_quest_nemesis} will have destroyed
the kami of {quest_quest_home} before you return again.
nethack.quest.sam.posthanks.text: {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} bows.  "{quest_player_name}-sama, tell us of your search for the Amulet."
nethack.quest.tou.assignquest.text:
"You have indeed proven yourself a worthy {quest_role_name}, {quest_player_name}.

"But now your kinfolk and I must ask you to put aside your travels and
help us in our time of need.  After you left us we elected a new mayor,
{quest_quest_nemesis}.  He proved to be a most heinous and vile creature.

"Soon after taking office he absconded with {quest_quest_artifact}
and fled town, leaving behind his henchmen to rule over us.  In order
for us to regain control of our town, you must enter {quest_intermediate_destination}
and recover {quest_quest_artifact}.

"Do not be distracted on your quest.  If you do not return quickly I fear
that all will be lost.  Let us both pray now that {quest_original_alignment_deity} will guide you
and keep you safe."
nethack.quest.tou.badalign.synopsis: [You are not sufficiently {quest_original_alignment}.  Return when you are.]
nethack.quest.tou.badalign.text:
"It would be an affront to {quest_original_alignment_deity} to have one not true to the
{quest_original_alignment} path undertake her bidding.

"You must not return to us until you have purified yourself of these
bad influences on your actions.  Remember, only by following the {quest_original_alignment}
path can you hope to overcome the obstacles you will face."
nethack.quest.tou.badlevel.text:
"There is still too much that you have to learn before you can undertake
the next step.  Return to us as a proven {quest_minimum_quest_rank}, and perhaps then
you will be ready.

"Go back now, and may the teachings of {quest_original_alignment_deity} serve you well."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_1: "I defeated {quest_quest_leader} and I will defeat you, {quest_player_name}."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_10: "How do you spell {quest_player_name}?  I want to ensure the marker on your grave is correct as a warning to your {quest_sibling_term_modifier_p}."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_2: "Where is {quest_original_alignment_deity} now!  You must realize no one can help you here."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_3: "Beg for mercy now and I may be lenient on you."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_4: "If you were not so {quest_original_alignment}, you might have stood a chance."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_6: "I only wish that {quest_quest_leader} had a more worthy {quest_current_rank} to send against me."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_7: "With {quest_quest_artifact} in my possession you cannot hope to defeat me."
nethack.quest.tou.discourage.item_9: "Are you truly the best {quest_quest_home} has to send against me?  I pity {quest_quest_leader}."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_1: "Do not be fooled by the false promises of {quest_quest_nemesis}."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_10: "Let all who meet you on your journey know that you are on a quest for {quest_quest_leader} and grant safe passage."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_2: "To enter {quest_intermediate_destination} you must pass many traps."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_3: "If you do not return with {quest_quest_artifact}, your quest will be in vain."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_4: "Do not be afraid to call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} if you truly need help."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_5: "If you do not destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}, he will follow you back here!"
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_6: "Take {quest_quest_artifact} from {quest_quest_nemesis} and you may be able to defeat him."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_8: "You are like {quest_child_term_modifier_a} to me, {quest_player_name}.  Do not let me down."
nethack.quest.tou.encourage.item_9: "If you are {quest_original_alignment} at all times you may succeed, {quest_player_name}."
nethack.quest.tou.firsttime.synopsis: [You find yourself back at {quest_quest_home}, but the quiet is ominous.]
nethack.quest.tou.firsttime.text:
You breathe a sigh of relief as you find yourself back in the familiar
surroundings of {quest_quest_home}.

You quickly notice that things do not appear the way they did when you
left.  The town is dark and quiet.  There are no sounds coming from
behind the town walls, and no campfires burning in the fields.  As a
matter of fact, you do not {quest_perception_verb} any movement in the fields at all, and
the crops seem as though they have been untended for many weeks.
nethack.quest.tou.goal_next.text:
You gain confidence, knowing that you may soon be united with
{quest_quest_artifact}.
nethack.quest.tou.gotit.synopsis: [You pick up {quest_quest_artifact} and feel relief.  Return it to {quest_quest_leader}.]
nethack.quest.tou.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel a great
weight has been lifted from your shoulders.  Your only thoughts are
to quickly return to {quest_quest_home} and find {quest_quest_leader}.
nethack.quest.tou.guardtalk_after.item_1: "Gehennom on 5 zorkmids a day -- more like 500 a day if you ask me."
nethack.quest.tou.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Do you know where I could find some nice postcards of The Gnomish Mines?"
nethack.quest.tou.guardtalk_after.item_4: "If you stick around, I'll show you the pictures from my latest trip."
nethack.quest.tou.guardtalk_after.item_5: "Did you bring me back any souvenirs?"
nethack.quest.tou.guardtalk_before.item_: "Gehennom on 5 zorkmids a day -- more like 500 a day if you ask me."
"Do you know where I could find some nice postcards of The Gnomish Mines?"
"Don't stay at the Inn, I hear the food is terrible and it has rats."
"They told me that this was the off season!"
nethack.quest.tou.hasamulet.synopsis: [You have the Amulet.  Take it to the Astral Plane to finish your task.]
nethack.quest.tou.hasamulet.text:
"Stand back and let me look at you, {quest_player_name}.
Now that you have recovered the Amulet of Yendor, I'm afraid living
out your days in {quest_quest_home} would seem pretty tame.

"You have come too far to stop now, for there are still more tasks that
our oral history foretells for you.  Forever more, though, your name shall
be spoken by the {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} with awe.  You are truly an inspiration to your
{quest_sibling_term_modifier_p}!"
nethack.quest.tou.killed_nemesis.text:
You turn in the direction of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  As his earthly body begins
to vanish before your eyes, you hear him curse:

    "You shall never be rid of me, {quest_player_name}!
    I will find you where ever you go and regain what is rightly mine."
nethack.quest.tou.leader_first.text:
"Is it really you, {quest_player_name}!  I had given up hope for your return.
As you can {quest_perception_verb}, we are desperately in need of your talents.  Someone must
defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} if our town is to become what it once was.

"Let me see if you are ready to be that someone."
nethack.quest.tou.leader_last.text:
"It is too late, {quest_player_name}.  You are not even worthy to die amongst us.
Leave {quest_quest_home} and never return."
nethack.quest.tou.leader_next.text: "Things are getting worse, {quest_player_name}.  I hope that this time you are ready."
nethack.quest.tou.leader_other.text: "I hope that for the sake of {quest_quest_home} you have prepared yourself this time."
nethack.quest.tou.locate_first.text:
Only your faith in {quest_original_alignment_deity} keeps you from trembling.  You {quest_perception_verb}
the handiwork of {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} henchlings everywhere.
nethack.quest.tou.locate_next.text: You know that this time you must find and destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}.
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_first.text:
"So, {quest_player_name}, {quest_quest_leader} thinks that you can wrest
{quest_quest_artifact} from me!

"It only proves how desperate he has become that he sends {quest_current_rank_modifier_a} to
try to defeat me.  When this day is over, I will have you enslaved
in the mines where you will rue the day that you ever entered
{quest_intermediate_destination}."
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_next.text:
"I let you live the last time because it gave me pleasure.
This time I will destroy you, {quest_player_name}."
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_other.synopsis: [Run away or you will suffer severely.]
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_other.text:
"These meetings come to bore me.  You disturb my workings with
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"If you do not run away now, I will inflict so much suffering on you that
{quest_quest_leader} will feel guilty for ever having sent his {quest_child_term} to me!"
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_wantsit.synops: ["Return {quest_quest_artifact} to me and we will rule {quest_quest_home}."]
nethack.quest.tou.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"You fool.  You do not know how to call upon the powers of
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"Return it to me and I will teach you how to use it, and together we
will rule {quest_quest_home}.  But do so now, as my patience grows thin."
nethack.quest.tou.nexttime.text: Once again, you are back at {quest_quest_home}.
nethack.quest.tou.offeredit.synopsis: [Take {quest_quest_artifact} and with {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} guidance, recover the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.tou.offeredit.text:
As {quest_quest_leader} detects the presence of {quest_quest_artifact},
he almost smiles for the first time in many a full moon.

As he looks up from {quest_quest_artifact} he says:

    "You have recovered {quest_quest_artifact}.  You are its
    owner now, but not its master.  Let it work with you as you continue
    your journey.  With its help, and {quest_original_alignment_deity} to guide you on the
    {quest_original_alignment} path, you may yet recover the Amulet of Yendor."
nethack.quest.tou.offeredit2.synopsis: [Keep {quest_quest_artifact} and return to {quest_dungeon_name} through the portal.]
nethack.quest.tou.offeredit2.text:
"{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is yours now.  {quest_dungeon_name}
await your return through the magic portal that brought you here."
nethack.quest.tou.othertime.text:
You are back at {quest_quest_home}.
Things appear to have become so bad that you fear that soon
{quest_quest_home} will not be here to return to.
nethack.quest.tou.posthanks.text:
"I could not be more proud than if you were my own {quest_child_term}, {quest_player_name}!
Tell me of your adventures in quest of the Amulet of Yendor."
nethack.quest.val.assignquest.text:
"It is not clear, {quest_player_name}, for my sight is limited without our relic.
But it is now likely that you can defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}, and recover
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"A short time ago, {quest_quest_nemesis} and his minions attacked this place.  They
opened the huge volcanic vents you {quest_perception_verb} about the hill, and attacked.  I knew
that this was to come to pass, and had asked {quest_original_alignment_deity} for a group of {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P}
to help defend this place.  The few you {quest_perception_verb} here are the mightiest of
Valhalla's own, and are all that are left of one hundred {quest_original_alignment_deity} sent.

"Despite the great and glorious battle we fought, {quest_quest_nemesis} managed at
last to steal {quest_quest_artifact}.  This has upset the balance of the universe,
and unless {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} is returned into my care, {quest_quest_nemesis} may start Ragnarok.

"You must find the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.  Travel downward
from there and you will find {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.  Defeat him and
return {quest_quest_artifact} to me."
nethack.quest.val.badalign.synopsis: [You have strayed from the {quest_original_alignment} path.  Return after you purify yourself.]
nethack.quest.val.badalign.text:
"NO!  This is terrible.  I see you becoming an ally of {quest_quest_nemesis}, and
leading his armies in the final great battles.  This must not come to
pass!  You have strayed from the {quest_original_alignment} path.  You must purge yourself,
and return here only when you have regained a state of purity."
nethack.quest.val.badlevel.text:
"I see you and {quest_quest_nemesis} fighting, {quest_player_name}.  But you are not prepared and
shall die at {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} hand if you proceed.  No.  This will not do.
Go back out into the world, and grow more experienced at the ways of war.
Only when you have returned {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a} will you be able to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}."
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_10: "Your body I destroy now, your soul when my hordes overrun Valhalla!"
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_2: "You cannot prevail, {quest_current_rank}.  I have foreseen your every move."
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_3: "With you out of the way, Valhalla will be mine for the taking."
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_4: "I killed scores of {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} best when I took {quest_quest_artifact}. Do you really think that one {quest_role_name} can stand against me?"
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_5: "Who bears the souls of {quest_role_name_modifier_P} to Valhalla, {quest_current_rank}?"
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_7: "Some instrument of {quest_original_alignment_deity} you are, {quest_player_name}.  You are a weakling!"
nethack.quest.val.discourage.item_8: "Never have I seen {quest_role_name_modifier_a} so clumsy in battle."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_2: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} when you are in need."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_3: "Use {quest_quest_artifact} if you can.  It will protect you."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_5: "To face {quest_quest_nemesis}, you will need to be immune to fire."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_7: "Trust in {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  He will not desert you."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_8: "It becomes more likely that Ragnarok will come with every passing moment. You must hurry, {quest_player_name}."
nethack.quest.val.encourage.item_9: "If {quest_quest_nemesis} can master {quest_quest_artifact}, he will be powerful enough to face {quest_original_alignment_deity} far earlier than is fated.  This must not be!"
nethack.quest.val.firsttime.synopsis: [You arrive below {quest_quest_home}.  Something is wrong; there is lava present.]
nethack.quest.val.firsttime.text:
You materialize at the base of a snowy hill.  Atop the hill sits
a place you know well, {quest_quest_home}.  You immediately realize
that something here is very wrong!

In places, the snow and ice have been melted into steaming pools of
water.  Fumaroles and pools of bubbling lava surround the hill.
The stench of sulphur is carried through the air, and you {quest_perception_verb} creatures
that should not be able to live in this environment moving towards you.
nethack.quest.val.goal_first.text:
Through clouds of sulphurous gasses, you {quest_perception_verb} a rock palisade
surrounded with a moat of bubbling lava.  You remember the description
from something that {quest_quest_leader} said.  This is the lair of {quest_quest_nemesis}.
nethack.quest.val.goal_next.text: Once again, you stand in sight of {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.
nethack.quest.val.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, your mind is suddenly filled with images,
and you perceive all of the possibilities of each potential choice you
could make.  As you begin to control and channel your thoughts, you
realize that you must return {quest_quest_artifact} to {quest_quest_leader} immediately.
nethack.quest.val.guardtalk_before.item_: "{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} weakens.  Without {quest_quest_artifact}, her foresight is dim."
"You must hurry, {quest_player_name}, else Ragnarok may well come."
"I would deal with this foul {quest_quest_nemesis} myself, but {quest_original_alignment_deity} forbids it."
nethack.quest.val.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} temple on the Astral Plane and offer it.]
nethack.quest.val.hasamulet.text:
"Excellent, {quest_player_name}.  I see you have recovered the Amulet!

"You must take the Amulet to the Great Temple of {quest_original_alignment_deity}, on the Astral
Plane.  There you must offer the Amulet to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.

"Go now, my {quest_child_term}.  I cannot tell you your fate, as the power of the
Amulet interferes with mine.  I hope for your success."
nethack.quest.val.killed_nemesis.text:
A look of surprise and horror appears on {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} face.

    "No!!!  {quest_quest_artifact} has lied to me!  I have been misled!"

Suddenly, {quest_quest_nemesis} grasps his head and screams in agony, then dies.
nethack.quest.val.leader_first.synopsis: [We need your aid.  Are you ready?]
nethack.quest.val.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}, my {quest_child_term}.  You have returned to {quest_quest_home}
at last.  We are in dire need of your aid, but I must determine if you
are yet ready for such an undertaking.

"Let me read your fate..."
nethack.quest.val.leader_last.synopsis: ["Begone from my presence and never return."]
nethack.quest.val.leader_last.text:
"No, {quest_player_name}.  Your fate is sealed.  I must cast about for another
champion.  Begone from my presence, and never return.  Know this, that
you shall never succeed in this life, and Valhalla is denied to you."
nethack.quest.val.leader_next.text:
"Let me read the future for you now, {quest_player_name}, perhaps you have managed to
change it enough..."
nethack.quest.val.leader_other.text:
"Again, I shall read your fate, my {quest_child_term}.  Let us both hope that you have
made changes to become ready for this task..."
nethack.quest.val.locate_first.text:
The ice and snow gives way to a valley floor.  You {quest_perception_verb} ahead of you
a huge round hill surrounded by pools of lava.  This then is the entrance
to {quest_intermediate_destination}.  It looks like you're not going to get in without
a fight though.
nethack.quest.val.locate_next.text: Once again, you stand before the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.
nethack.quest.val.nemesis_first.synopsis: ["{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} has shown me that I must kill you."]
nethack.quest.val.nemesis_first.text:
"So!  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} has finally sent {quest_role_name_modifier_a} to challenge me!

"I thought that mastering {quest_quest_artifact} would enable me to challenge
{quest_original_alignment_deity}, but it has shown me that first I must kill you!  So come, little
{quest_sibling_term}.  Once I defeat you, I can at last begin the final battle with {quest_original_alignment_deity}."
nethack.quest.val.nemesis_next.text: "Again you challenge me, {quest_current_rank}.  Good.  I will kill you now."
nethack.quest.val.nemesis_other.text: "Have you not learned yet?  You cannot defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}!"
nethack.quest.val.nemesis_wantsit.text: "I will kill you, {quest_role_name}, and wrest {quest_quest_artifact} from your mangled hands."
nethack.quest.val.nexttime.text: Once again, you are near the abode of {quest_quest_leader}.
nethack.quest.val.offeredit.text:
As you approach, {quest_quest_leader} rises and touches {quest_quest_artifact}.

"You may take {quest_quest_artifact} with you, {quest_player_name}.  I have removed from
it the power to foretell the future, for that power no mortal should
have.  Its other abilities, however, you have at your disposal.

"You must now begin in {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} name to search for the Amulet of Yendor.
May your steps be guided by {quest_original_alignment_deity}, my {quest_child_term}."
nethack.quest.val.offeredit2.synopsis: [You are {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_s} keeper now.  Return through the portal and find the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.val.offeredit2.text:
"Careful, {quest_player_name}!  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} might break, and that would be
a tragic loss.  You are its keeper now, and the time has come to
resume your search for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your
return through the magic portal that brought you here."
nethack.quest.val.othertime.text:
Again you materialize near {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} abode.  You have a nagging feeling
that this may be the last time you come here.
nethack.quest.val.posthanks.text:
"Greetings, {quest_player_name}.  I have not been able to pay as much attention to
your search for the Amulet as I have wished.  How do you fare?"
nethack.quest.wiz.assignquest.text:
"Yes, {quest_player_name}, you truly are ready for this dire task.  Listen,
carefully, for what I tell you now will be of vital importance.

"Since you left us to hone your skills in the world, we unexpectedly came
under attack by the forces of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  As you know, we thought
{quest_quest_nemesis} had perished at the end of the last age, but, alas, this was
not the case.

"{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} sent an army of abominations against us.  Among them was a
minion, mindless and ensorcelled, and thus, in the confusion, it was
able to penetrate our defenses.  Alas, this creature has stolen
{quest_quest_artifact} and I fear has delivered {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} to {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"Over the years, I had woven most of my power into this amulet, and thus,
without it, I have but a shadow of my former power, and I fear that I
shall soon perish.

"You must travel to {quest_intermediate_destination}, and within its dungeons,
find and overcome {quest_quest_nemesis}, and return {quest_quest_artifact} to me.

"Go now, with {quest_original_alignment_deity}, and complete this quest before it is too late."
nethack.quest.wiz.badalign.synopsis: [Go; come back when you are worthy of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
nethack.quest.wiz.badalign.text:
"You amaze me, {quest_player_name}!  How many times did I tell you that the way of a mage
is an exacting one.  One must use the world with care, lest one leave it
in ruins and simplify the task of {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"You must go back and show your worthiness.  Do not return until you are
truly ready for this quest.  May {quest_original_alignment_deity} guide you in this task."
nethack.quest.wiz.badlevel.text:
"Alas, {quest_player_name}, you have not yet shown your proficiency as a worthy
spellcaster.  As {quest_current_rank_modifier_a}, you would surely be overcome in the challenge
ahead.  Go, now, expand your horizons, and return when you have attained
renown as {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}."
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_1: "Your puny powers are no match for me, fool!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_10: "Feel my power, {quest_role_name}!  My victory is imminent!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_2: "When you are defeated, your torment will last for a thousand years."
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_3: "After your downfall, {quest_player_name}, I shall devour {quest_quest_leader} for dessert!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_4: "Are you ready yet to beg for mercy?  I could be lenient..."
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_5: "Your soul shall join the enslaved multitude I command!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_6: "Your lack of will is evident, and you shall die as a result."
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_7: "Your faith in {quest_original_alignment_deity} is for naught!  Come, submit to me now!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_8: "A mere {quest_current_rank} is nothing compared to my skill!"
nethack.quest.wiz.discourage.item_9: "So, you are the best hope of {quest_quest_leader}?  How droll."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_1: "Beware, for {quest_quest_nemesis} is immune to most magical attacks."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_10: "You will know when {quest_quest_artifact} is near.  Proceed with care!"
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_2: "To enter {quest_intermediate_destination} you must pass many traps."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_3: "{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} may be vulnerable to physical attacks."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_4: "{quest_original_alignment_deity} will come to your aid when you call."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_5: "You must utterly destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}.  He will pursue you otherwise."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_6: "{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is a mighty artifact.  With it you can destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_8: "I will have my {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} watch for your return."
nethack.quest.wiz.encourage.item_9: "Feel free to take any items in that chest that might aid you."
nethack.quest.wiz.firsttime.synopsis: [You have arrived at {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} tower but something is very wrong.]
nethack.quest.wiz.firsttime.text:
You are suddenly in familiar surroundings.  You notice what appears to
be a large, squat stone structure nearby.  Wait!  That looks like the
tower of your former teacher, {quest_quest_leader}.

However, things are not the same as when you were last here.  Mists and
areas of unexplained darkness surround the tower.  There is movement in
the shadows.

Your teacher would never allow such unaesthetic forms to surround the
tower...  unless something were dreadfully wrong!
nethack.quest.wiz.goal_first.text: You feel your mentor's presence; perhaps {quest_quest_artifact} is nearby.
nethack.quest.wiz.goal_next.text: The aura of {quest_quest_artifact} tingles at the edge of your perception.
nethack.quest.wiz.gotit.synopsis: [You feel {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_s} power and know you should return {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} to {quest_quest_leader}.]
nethack.quest.wiz.gotit.text:
As you touch {quest_quest_artifact}, its comforting power infuses you
with new energy.  You feel as if you can detect others' thoughts flowing
through it.  Although you yearn to wear {quest_quest_artifact} and
attack the Wizard of Yendor, you know you must return it to its rightful
owner, {quest_quest_leader}.
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_after.item_1: "I have some eye of newt to trade, do you have a spare blind-worm's sting?"
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_after.item_2: "The magic portal now seems like it will remain stable for quite some time."
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_after.item_3: "Have you noticed how much stronger {quest_quest_leader} is since {quest_quest_artifact} was recovered?"
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_after.item_4: "Thank {quest_original_alignment_deity}!  We weren't positive you would defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}."
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_after.item_5: "I, too, will venture into the world, because {quest_quest_nemesis} was but one of many evils to be vanquished."
nethack.quest.wiz.guardtalk_before.item_: "Would you happen to have some eye of newt in that overstuffed pack, {quest_sibling_term}?"
"Ah, the spell to create the magic portal worked.  Outstanding!"
"Hurry!  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} may not survive that casting of the portal spell!"
"The spells of {quest_quest_nemesis} were just too powerful for us to withstand."
"I, too, will venture into the world, because {quest_quest_nemesis} is but one of many evils to be vanquished."
nethack.quest.wiz.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} altar on the Astral Plane.]
nethack.quest.wiz.hasamulet.text:
"Congratulations, {quest_player_name}.  I always knew that if anyone could succeed
in defeating the Wizard of Yendor and his minions, it would be you.

"Go now, and take the Amulet to the Astral Plane.  Once there, present
the Amulet on the altar of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Along the way you shall pass through
the four Elemental Planes.  These planes are like nothing you have ever
experienced before, so be prepared!

"For this you were born, {quest_sibling_term}!  I am very proud of you."
nethack.quest.wiz.killed_nemesis.text:
{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C}, whose body begins to shrivel up, croaks out:

    "I shall haunt your progress until the end of time.  A thousand
    curses on you and {quest_quest_leader}."

Then, the body bursts into a cloud of choking dust, and blows away.
nethack.quest.wiz.leader_first.synopsis: [You have come a long way, but are you ready for the task I require?]
nethack.quest.wiz.leader_first.text:
"Come closer, {quest_player_name}, for my voice falters in my old age.
Yes, I see that you have come a long way since you went out into the
world, leaving the safe confines of this tower.  However, I must first
determine if you have all of the skills required to take on the task
I require of you."
nethack.quest.wiz.leader_last.text:
"You fool, {quest_player_name}!  Why did I waste all of those years teaching you
the esoteric arts?  Get out of here!  I shall find another."
nethack.quest.wiz.leader_next.text: "Well, {quest_player_name}, you have returned.  Perhaps you are now ready..."
nethack.quest.wiz.leader_other.text:
"This is getting tedious, {quest_player_name}, but perseverance is a sign of a true mage.
I certainly hope that you are truly ready this time!"
nethack.quest.wiz.locate_first.text: Wisps of fog swirl nearby.  You feel that {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair is close.
nethack.quest.wiz.locate_next.text: You believe that you may once again invade {quest_intermediate_destination}.
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_first.synopsis: ["Your destruction should make for good sport."]
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_first.text:
"Ah, I recognize you, {quest_player_name}.  So, {quest_quest_leader} has sent you to steal
{quest_quest_artifact} from me, hmmm?  Well, {quest_quest_leader_modifier_h} is a fool to send such
a mental weakling against me.

"Your destruction, however, should make for good sport.  In the end, you
shall beg me to kill you!"
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_next.synopsis: ["Your soul shall soon be mine to command."]
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_next.text:
"How nice of you to return, {quest_player_name}!  I enjoyed our last meeting.  Are you
still hungry for more pain?

"Come!  Your soul, like {quest_quest_artifact}, shall soon be mine to command."
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_other.text:
"I'm sure that your perseverance shall be the subject of innumerable
ballads, but you shall not be around to hear them, I fear!"
nethack.quest.wiz.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"Thief!  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} belongs to me, now.  I shall feed
your living flesh to my minions."
nethack.quest.wiz.nexttime.text: Once again, you are back at {quest_quest_home}.
nethack.quest.wiz.offeredit.synopsis: [Take {quest_quest_artifact} with you in your quest for the Amulet.]
nethack.quest.wiz.offeredit.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} notices {quest_quest_artifact} in your possession,
beams at you and says:

    "I knew you could defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} and retrieve
    {quest_quest_artifact}.  We shall never forget this
    brave service.

    "Take {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h} with you in your quest for the Amulet of Yendor.
    I can sense that it has attuned {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_i}self to you already.

    "May {quest_original_alignment_deity} guide you in your quest, and keep you from harm."
nethack.quest.wiz.offeredit2.synopsis: [Keep {quest_quest_artifact}, return through the portal to {quest_dungeon_name}; find the other Amulet.]
nethack.quest.wiz.offeredit2.text:
"You are the keeper of {quest_quest_artifact} now.  It is time to
recover the /other/ Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your return through
the magic portal which brought you here."
nethack.quest.wiz.othertime.text:
You are back at {quest_quest_home}.
You have an odd feeling this may be the last time you ever come here.
nethack.quest.wiz.posthanks.text:
"Come near, my {quest_child_term}, and share your adventures with me.
So, have you succeeded in your quest for the Amulet of Yendor?"
